description: This Java source file defines the LauncherServer class, which implements a local server for managing connections from client processes in the Spark launcher framework. It handles client registration, connection acceptance, message handling, and resource cleanup, facilitating communication between Spark applications and their launchers.

classes.name: LauncherServer
classes.description: A server that listens locally for connections from clients launched by the Spark launcher library, managing client sessions and communication.

classes.name: LauncherServer.ServerConnection
classes.description: Inner class representing a client connection, handling message processing and connection lifecycle.

methods.name: getOrCreateServer
methods.description: Creates or retrieves the singleton instance of LauncherServer, starting it if necessary.

methods.name: registerHandle
methods.description: Registers a client handle and returns a secret for client connection identification.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the server and releases resources.

methods.name: ref
methods.description: Increments the reference count for the server instance.

methods.name: unref
methods.description: Decrements the reference count and closes the server if no longer referenced.

methods.name: getPort
methods.description: Returns the port number the server is listening on.

methods.name: unregister
methods.description: Removes a client handle from pending list and decrements server reference.

methods.name: acceptConnections
methods.description: Main loop accepting incoming client connections.

methods.name: createSecret
methods.description: Generates a unique secret string for client identification.
